findings.issue: Coverage records 50% scoped and 25% diff-coverage (1/4), yet its test file DeleteContactTypeDialog.test.tsx (5 tests: closed, confirm + Cancel focus, server error alert, disabled while deleting, axe) is committed and passes 5/5 when I ran it under the slot. The 50% is most likely a coverage artifact (stale or partial merge), but I could not reproduce it. My own targeted coverage run printed no table row for the file, so it is not a confirmation either way.
findings.recommendation: Re-run scoped web coverage at the final SHA and confirm this file reaches ~100%; if it stays low, find why the tests do not register against it.

findings.issue: Branch 80.88% and function 80.95% are below 90% per file; only the 13-file aggregate (B 90.91) clears the bar. ContactTypeList and ContactTypeDialog are also in the low 80s on branches or functions.
findings.recommendation: Add tests for the uncovered error and branch paths, or record the aggregate-only rationale.

findings.issue: Domain lines 95.25% is a thin margin over the >95% target; it is a package-wide figure, not PG-205 files only.

Test quality spot-check is positive. Account ordering is asserted on call order (replace then info; info then unlink). Segment tests assert query args and URL replace. 'Save default' asserts no mutate on radio move, then a mutate with {id:null}. Fixed-date fixtures use literal dates only as data, with no wall-clock comparison found in the PG-205 tests I grepped. I did not read every test.
Index compiled after the fact. Some RED logs predate the commit that fixed them (HEAD in the log header is the parent), which is normal TDD.

initial_verdict.summary: Tests and coverage are acceptable: 0 failures across the 7 touched-package suites, integration and tools; diff-coverage 95.4% vs the 80% floor; scoped aggregate S 96.46 / B 90.91 / F 92.40 / L 97.21; domain lines 95.25%. TDD RED/GREEN pairs are consistent and the spot-checked tests have real assertions. Verdict is WARN, not PASS, for three reasons. (1) DeleteContactTypeDialog.tsx shows 25-50% coverage that contradicts its passing 5-test file and is unresolved. (2) Several web files sit below 90% per file, passing only in aggregate. (3) The full web/api/validators suites ran at e929eb220, not the final tree. The two later commits were re-verified by targeted logs only, and pre-ship at 3ae41b2df is still the outstanding full-suite check. I read logs and ran only one targeted web test under the slot; I did not re-run the suites.
